CustomField.label: Date Format
CustomField.description: Optional Apex/Java date pattern (e.g. "MMMM d, yyyy", "dd/MM/yyyy") applied to date and datetime fields in this document. Leave blank to use the signer's native Salesforce locale format.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Blank = native locale date (e.g. 9/15/2026). Set a pattern like MMMM d, yyyy for "September 15, 2026".
